description: Parkering is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Linköpings kommun. This open data describes the current status of the number of vacancies in the parking garages in Linköping city. The information is updated immediately when cars drive in and out of the car parks. See documentation at. Coverage: Linköpings kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Parking" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Linköpings kommun. Its keywords include parkeringsplats, parkering. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
